rules.win: After 6 rounds the player with the most point tokens wins. Ties break by the role-card suit matching the most often-shown Keystone faces with the fewest mismatches, then by elder.
rules.round: The Forger seals and peeks the Keystone (truth A/B), then claims a side on their own Toggle. Each other player trusts (sets own Toggle to the claimed side) or challenges. A challenge reveals the Toggle: match with Keystone = challenger wrong; mismatch = challenger right. Noble challenge takes the pot; failed challenge pays 1. If nobody challenges the pot banks (+2) and every truthful player scores 1.
